name: ARound'It
summary:
Record restaurant reviews, local information, and small daily life on AR sticky notes,
Share it in the AR space.
Get away from the pressure of small phone screens and scrolling.
Find useful information in real space.
Nothing special to do. Just take out your phone and scan the space with your camera and you're done!
It's even better because ARound'It automatically translates other users' memos even when you're in a foreign country where you don't understand the language.
